payload.summary: Switched to @strudel/repl hidden editor; @strudel/web lacks soundfonts for gm_* sounds
Added cache-busting fetch + Safari AudioContext resume inside user gesture
AudioContext constructor interception + resume passes for Safari suspended contexts

Added Safari background-tab audio recovery: visibilitychange + focus listeners, AudioContext onstatechange auto-resume, Media Session API integration; refactored click handler into playAudio()/stopAudio().

Added inline worker-timers monkey-patch of window.setInterval/clearInterval so Strudel's scheduler uses a Web Worker (like strudel.cc does with the 'worker-timers' npm pkg) — prevents Safari from stopping playback in background tabs.
